label: Vla
note: Dutch dairy dessert from fresh milk; traditionally eggs, sugar and milk, industrial vla often cornstarch instead of eggs; first documented in the 13th century

about.text: A Dutch custard-like milk dessert sold in cartons, in vanilla, chocolate and other flavours.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Milk is thickened with starch (or egg) and sweetened, then cooled until it sets to a soft spoonable cream. Industrial vla is heat-treated, but no temperatures or times were found in an opened source.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: With eggs or maize starch (maizena), sugar and vanilla.
Cooled until it sets to a soft spoonable cream.
